question: Which seed-syllable embodying the form of bhaga should be recited?
premises: Recitation of a seed-syllable is enjoined
It embodies the form of bhaga
inference: One should recite the seed-syllable called bhaga, which has the form of bhaga
uncertainties: bhagāravyaṃ is an unusual form; taken as designation
plain_english: O beautiful-hipped one, one should recite the seed-syllable called bhaga, having the form of bhaga.
